name: GS1-Conformant Resolver Standard 1.2.1
status: Release 1.2.1 ratified August 2026 (standards page and PDF print no day); the archive page on ref.gs1.org lists "Published 19 August 2026".
relevance: The standard links an entity identified by a GS1 Digital Link URI, which carries a key such as a GTIN or a Global Location Number (GLN), to multiple sources of related information "in a way that is machine-discoverable and machine-actionable" (section 1), for example product information pages, product data and service APIs (section 2). The query string "does not form part of the entity's identifier", and for a valid URI with no information the resolver returns a simple 404 Not Found (sections 2.12, 2.4.1). On success it "SHALL redirect to the default link unless there is information in the request that can be used to determine a better response" (section 2.6.1); the prose gives no status code for the redirect, and the flowchart in Figure 2-1 shows 307. With `linkType=linkset` or the Accept header `application/linkset+json` it does not redirect and returns the links as an RFC 9264 linkset, and a conformant resolver publishes a Resolver Description File at /.well-known/gs1resolver (sections 2.9, 2.10). The Log of Changes records that an earlier SHOULD to recognise schema.org terms "has been removed although, of course, resolvers MAY use such terms."
boundary: Out of scope: identical targets or linksets across resolvers, and any particular behaviour for query string parameters.
